short_description: Sweet home Chattanooga! Tried and true, this hopping small city has been a fantastic venue for our event for many years past, and we're looking forward to the repeat visit! Come celebrate the most iconic German coupes of the 60s, 70s, 80s and 90s as we return to the shore of the Tennessee River in downtown Chattanooga, TN!
description:
Sweet home Chattanooga! Tried and true, this hopping small city has been a fantastic venue for our event for many years past, and we're looking forward to the repeat visit!

Come celebrate the most iconic German coupes of the 60s, 70s, 80s and 90s as we return to the shore of the Tennessee River in downtown Chattanooga, TN!  Starting April 27th, Southeast Sharkfest will celebrate its 19th annual gathering (and 20th anniversary) in one of the most historic railway cities of the South.  Our Friday country drive will offer a relaxing view of the Tennessee Valley followed by our Saturday concours and awards dinner.

short_description: At long last registration has begun for Southeast Sharkfest 2017!  Come celebrate our 15th anniversary as the big coupes rendezvous at beautiful Chateau Elan in Braselton, GA.  Sure to please the whole family, this 3500 acre property hosts a varieties of amenities including a full service spa, 63-hole championship golf course, and numerous on-site restaurants.
description: At long last registration has begun for Southeast Sharkfest 2017!  Come celebrate our 15th anniversary as the big coupes rendezvous at beautiful Chateau Elan in Braselton, GA.  Sure to please the whole family, this 3500 acre property hosts a varieties of amenities including a full service spa, 63-hole championship golf course, and numerous on-site restaurants.  Scenic North Georgia provides for some beautiful drives and the Saturday concours will be held the shadow of the spectacular onsite winery.

short_description:
***REGISTRATION FOR SOUTHEAST SHARKFEST 2014 HAS CLOSED***  

The 2014 festivities will commence on May 1st and close on May 4th.  We have a fantastic itinerary lined up, which includes an amazing show venue: the Zentrum at BMW Manufacturing.  Those who register will also have an opportunity to experience a BMW Performance Drive, and listen to a great talk by author and columnist Rob Siegel who will be joining us.  We would like to extend a warm welcome the e9/e31 chassis owners, as we add them to the judged classes for the 2014 event.  This is not a year to miss!
description:
***REGISTRATION FOR SOUTHEAST SHARKFEST 2014 HAS CLOSED***  

The 2014 Southeast Sharkfest festivities will kick off in Spartanburg, South Carolina on the morning of Friday, May 2nd and will conclude on the morning of Sunday, May 5th.  As usual, there will be a Thursday night gathering for dinner on May 1st for the early arrivals.  Don't forget about the BMW Performance Center experience that we have arranged for Saturday morning.  It'll be just about the most fun you can have with your clothes on!  Saturday we will be joined by Rob Siegel, columnist and author of "Memoirs of a Hack Mechanic" who will speak during the awards ceremony.
